I think something like this in your own words should be sent to NH
I had told jeffrey last year , that you
wanted to give some money to his favorite charity as a thank you , for spending so much time and energy to
help us both. He has done more for you and I , then ordinary friendship would dictate. He told me he gave
you a list of four of his favorites. none of the money goes to him, they are all solid institutions . I would
apprecitate it if you would make a really grand gesture to demonstrate our thanks , 10 million for each, for
example. His name will not be involved.
